variants.name: 01-navy-wave
variants.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup / shareable wallet QR graphic. Create ONE finished portrait 4:5 shareable image card that would be sent as a PNG attachment on WhatsApp. NOT a screenshot, NOT a phone screen, NO phone frame, NO status bar, NO close, NO buttons, NO copy icon, NO share or save controls, NO 'Only this card will be shared'. Edge-to-edge finished card, polished and crisp. Socially coastal visual language: deep navy #173652, navy ink #102C46, snowy white, icy blue #E5EDF7, refined editorial serif headings with clean sans utility text. Reference 1 is Socially's compact navy card concept for style only; reference 2 is the actual captain logo to use accurately. Include small captain logo + SOCIALLY brand lockup, a single Solana badge. Central focus must be large dark navy QR on pure white, generous quiet zone, no logo or graphics covering modules. QR illustrative only. Text restrained: heading 'Receive on Solana', subtitle 'Scan to send to my wallet', label 'Wallet Address:', full sample address '2xv2aWMUEesXsbTwFwQcxNrJn4HebPVBCrYihQ8K3Zvg' in readable monospaced two lines, footer 'Send only SOL and Solana tokens'. No financial amounts, no slogan, no person or device, no neon colors. This is the actual designed SHARED IMAGE, not the surrounding application. Compact navy brand header with tiny compass watermark on far right, shallow icy wave into white body. Serif heading on white, large QR centered, full address in subtle ice-blue footer panel. Most faithful to selected app direction. Plenty of whitespace; restrained contemporary finish.
